name: Model Predictive Control (MPC)
summary: Optimize controls over a finite receding horizon using a predictive state-transition model.
summary_zh: 在有限未来时域内求解控制优化，并随新观测滚动重规划。
core_idea: Repeatedly optimize constrained future actions, execute an initial part, then replan.
innovation: Provides a transparent decision interface between model predictions and control actions.
limitations: Performance depends on model accuracy, constraints and planning horizon.

start_here.why: Influential peer-reviewed survey of MPC design and implementation.
start_here.focus: Receding horizon, constraints and computational tradeoffs.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
